# LinkPasteController

> Converts selected text into a hyperlink when a URL is pasted. If the user has text selected in a contenteditable input and pastes clipboard content that looks like a URL, the selected text is wrapped in an <a> element pointing to the pasted URL. If no text is selected, the paste proceeds normally. Events: - `native:link-paste` — dispatched on host when a link is created. Detail: `{ url, text, element }`

**Trait name:** `link-paste` (for use with `<n-controller traits="link-paste">` or self-trait `traits="link-paste"`)

## Constructor

```ts
new LinkPasteController(host: HTMLElement, options?: LinkPasteOptions)
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Required | Description |
|--------|------|----------|-------------|
| `input` | `HTMLElement` | yes |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | no |  |

## Events Dispatched

| Event | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| `native:link-paste` | `{ url, text, element }` |

## Methods

| Method | Parameters | Returns |
|--------|------------|---------|
| `destroy()` | `—` | `void` |

## Behavior

- **Paste event with text selected and URL in clipboard** → Validates clipboard content as URL (https://, http://, ftp://, //), Replaces selected text with an <a> element, Sets href to pasted URL, target=_blank, rel=noopener noreferrer, Dispatches native:link-paste with url, text, and element
- **Paste event with no text selected** → No-op — paste proceeds normally
- **Paste event with non-URL content and text selected** → No-op — paste proceeds normally

## Consumption Patterns

### 1. Imperative (Controller)

```ts
import { LinkPasteController } from '@nonoun/native-ui';
const ctrl = new LinkPasteController(element, { /* options */ });
// In teardown: ctrl.destroy();
```

### 2. Declarative (Provider)

```html
<n-controller traits="link-paste">
  <div>Target element</div>
</n-controller>
```

### 3. Self-trait

```html
<n-button traits="link-paste">Self-applying</n-button>
```

### Trait Option Attributes

When used as a provider or self-trait, options are passed via `data-trait-link-paste-*` attributes:

```html
<n-controller traits="link-paste" data-trait-link-paste-input="value">
  <div>Target</div>
</n-controller>
```
